title: Structural insights into YheS-mediated release of SecM-arrested ribosome.
authors: Iso, Kaishi; Ikeda, Toma; Yamasaki, Kohei; Ando, Yushin; Sano, Fumiya K; Furuta, Tadaomi; Taguchi, Hideki; Nureki, Osamu; Chadani, Yuhei; Itoh, Yuzuru
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜和分子动力学模拟研究ABCF蛋白YheS如何释放核糖体上SecM停滞肽，核心是蛋白质-核糖体/RNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未涉及TF-DNA结合或DNA建模，仅MD方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: ATP-binding cassette subfamily F (ABCF) proteins interact with the ribosome to resolve translation defects near the peptidyl transferase center (PTC). In Escherichia coli, four ABCF proteins (EttA, Uup, YbiT, and YheS) selectively promote translation of distinct problematic nascent peptide sequences, but their molecular mechanisms remain unclear. Here, we present a 2.8 A cryo-EM structure of the ribosome in complex with an ATPase-deficient mutant of YheS and investigate how it releases ribosomes arrested by the SecM nascent chain. YheS binds to the ribosomal E-site via the L1 stalk, and its P-site tRNA-interaction motif (PtIM) extends toward the PTC, displacing the CCA end of the P-site tRNA. Notably, the cryo-EM density corresponding to the SecM nascent chain within the exit tunnel is largely lost upon YheS binding. These observations suggest that YheS relieves peptide sequence-dependent stalling by perturbing nascent chain-tunnel interactions through P-site tRNA relocation. Steered molecular dynamics simulations provide qualitative support for this model. Together, our findings provide mechanistic insight into a mode of arrest release distinct from the translocon-mediated release mechanism.
abstract_zh: ATP结合盒F亚家族（ABCF）蛋白与核糖体相互作用，以解决肽基转移酶中心（PTC）附近的翻译缺陷。在大肠杆菌中，四种ABCF蛋白（EttA、Uup、YbiT和YheS）选择性地促进不同问题新生肽序列的翻译，但其分子机制仍不清楚。在此，我们展示了核糖体与ATP酶缺陷型YheS突变体复合物的2.8 Å冷冻电镜结构，并研究了其如何释放被SecM新生链阻滞的核糖体。YheS通过L1柄结合至核糖体E位点，其P位点tRNA相互作用基序（PtIM）延伸至PTC，取代P位点tRNA的CCA末端。值得注意的是，对应于出口通道内SecM新生链的冷冻电镜密度在YheS结合后大部分消失。这些观察结果表明，YheS通过P位点tRNA重定位扰动新生链-通道相互作用，从而解除肽序列依赖性停滞。定向分子动力学模拟为该模型提供了定性支持。综合来看，我们的发现为一种不同于转座子介导释放机制的停滞释放模式提供了机制性见解。
